lead: A bell with the number of unread notifications that opens the list: unread ones dotted with a button that marks them read, an open button for those with something to open, and "Mark all as read". What pressing a button does is yours; a button appears when its callback is given.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: `items` are the notifications, newest first; `onRead`, `onReadAll` and `onOpen` give the buttons.
usage.n1: Ben mentioned you in a note
usage.n3: A ticket was assigned to you

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: The list is the `notification-bell` slot (`notification-bell.css`: its width); the rest is Popover, Badge, List and Button.
